messages:
emily: Heads up: publish-batch-821 to eu-ecr hit quarantines — deploybot reports 409 on manifest attach. Several services blocked for 3.13.0 promotion.
kevin: which services?
emily: runtime, sdk, webhook, router (8/20 quarantined). Job id publish-batch-821.
ci-bot: publish-batch-821 started by @emily at 2024-11-20T07:12:19Z
deploybot: publish-batch-821: 12/20 pushed, 8/20 quarantined. Error: MANIFEST_PUSH_CONFLICT. Conflicting signer key ids: kms-eu-05 vs kms-eu-06.
nate: looks like KMS rotation completed at 07:00UTC; mirrors didn't finish re-signing.
emily: log excerpt: "PUT manifest -> 409 Conflict: existing signed_by=kms-eu-05 created=2024-11-20T06:58:03Z incoming key=kms-eu-06"
kevin: impact? any user-facing failures yet?
emily: no customer failures, but EU canary now mixes old/new images. Risk of incompat for a few minutes.
nate: plan: pause rollout, pin prod tag to previous digest, and queue a resign-republish once mirrors reconciled.
kevin: agree. pinning is lower risk. Emily can you run pinback and update RR ticket?
emily: doing pinback -> ./release-tools pinback --release=3.13.0 --digest=sha256:stable888 --scope=prod --note="paused: eu manifest signer mismatch"
ci-bot: pinback succeeded, prod routing pinned to sha256:stable888
emily: updated RR-475 with notes and ETA 40m. ops-bot, can you confirm mirror-resign progress?
ops-bot: mirror resign progress: 10/18 repos complete, estimated 35m to finish.
kevin: OK. watch rules: deploybot should not unpause until quarantines==0 and signature_state == all-kms-eu-06. Nate please run resign-republish once ops confirms.
nate: will do. Also adding a canary healthguard: if error-rate > 0.5% auto rollback to pinned digest.
emily: thanks. I'll draft a small customer-facing note in case window extends.
kevin: good. follow-ups: postmortem after cleanup and consider adding a pre-publish verification to check key consistency across mirrors.
emily: noted — opening RFC for pre-publish mirror-sign check. :thumbsup:
